description: Defines a data transfer object class 'NationalitySearchFilterParams' used for filtering nationality search queries within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends generic filter parameters and specifies allowed sort fields with an initial default.

classes.name: NationalitySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filter parameters for nationality search, including sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'n.name'.
